item.fpvdrone.fpv_goggles.usage: Right-click a drone to link. Equip while the drone has a battery. Shift+Scroll to switch video channels.
item.fpvdrone.drone.usage: Place on solid ground. Right-click with the remote and goggles to link them. Insert a battery. Optionally attach an RPG-7 Round.
item.fpvdrone.battery.usage: Remove from drone: hold Shift and right-click.
item.fpvdrone.rpg7.usage: Right-click the drone to attach. Detonates on impact.
item.fpvdrone.betaflight.usage: Right-click a drone to configure the OSD screen.
fpvdrone.config.header:
Edit values and restart the game to apply.
Works on both client and dedicated server.
Server values override client settings for all players.
fpvdrone.config.section.signalNote:
(When simpleRange > 0, distance values are auto-scaled
 and the manual values below are ignored.)
fpvdrone.config.simpleRange:
Quick range setup. Set to your desired max range in blocks
and ALL distance parameters below will auto-scale.
Set to 0 to disable and configure manually.
fpvdrone.config.maxRange:
Maximum flight range in blocks. Signal drops to zero beyond this
distance and the drone enters failsafe.
fpvdrone.config.freezeStartDistance:
Distance (blocks) at which the video feed starts stuttering.
Below this distance the picture is perfectly clean.
fpvdrone.config.obstaclePenaltyMultiplie:
Signal penalty strength for blocks between pilot and drone.
0.0 = obstacles have no effect. 1.0 = default. 2.0 = twice as strong.
fpvdrone.config.groundProximityPenaltyMa:
Maximum signal penalty (%) applied when flying low to the ground
at long range. Simulates ground-level RF attenuation. 0 = disabled.
fpvdrone.config.groundProximityDistanceS:
Distance (blocks) at which the ground-proximity penalty starts.
Closer than this threshold = no penalty.
fpvdrone.config.groundProximityHeightThr:
Height above ground (blocks) below which the drone is considered
low-flying for the purpose of the ground-proximity penalty.
fpvdrone.config.heightBonusPerBlock:
Signal bonus per block of altitude above the height baseline.
Higher altitude = better signal. 0 = no bonus.
fpvdrone.config.heightBaseline:
Y-level above which the altitude bonus starts to apply.
Flying below this level gives no bonus.
fpvdrone.config.signalSmoothing:
How quickly signal strength responds to changes.
Low values = slow, cinematic transitions. High = near-instant.
fpvdrone.config.zeroSignalFramesForDisco:
Number of consecutive zero-signal frames before the failsafe
triggers. Higher = more tolerant of brief signal loss.
fpvdrone.config.freezeIntensity:
How aggressively the video stutters as signal degrades.
Higher = more freeze frames at range. 0 = no freeze effect.
fpvdrone.config.failsafeDescentRate:
Descent speed (blocks/tick) when the signal is lost.
The drone slowly drops until it lands or regains signal.
fpvdrone.config.failsafeHorizontalDampin:
Horizontal speed multiplier per tick during failsafe.
1.0 = no braking. 0.0 = instant horizontal stop.
fpvdrone.config.explosionBlockPower:
Block-destruction power. 0.0 = no blocks broken.
1.0 = equivalent to vanilla TNT. 2.0 = double strength.
fpvdrone.config.explosionBlastRadius: Radius (blocks) of the blast-wave damage pass.
fpvdrone.config.explosionBlastDamage: Peak blast-wave damage dealt at the edge of the kill zone.
fpvdrone.config.explosionKillZone:
Instant-kill radius (blocks). Entities inside this radius
die regardless of armor or distance.
fpvdrone.config.explosionOpensDoors:
When true, the blast forces all doors, trapdoors, and
fence gates in the blast radius into the OPEN state.
fpvdrone.config.kamikazeExplosionPower:
Explosion power for kamikaze / RPG drone detonations.
Scales shrapnel radius and damage output.
fpvdrone.config.shrapnelCount:
Number of shrapnel rays cast per explosion.
More rays = better hit detection through cover, but higher CPU cost.
fpvdrone.config.droneCollisionDamage:
When true, drones deal impact damage to entities
(mobs and players) on collision.
fpvdrone.config.droneObserverRange:
Entity tracking range for drones (blocks). Controls how far
observers can see drone movement and animations.
Server-side only — not synced to clients.
